units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 90b:6">B. Bath. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>תרעא ח׳ וכ׳</he> the early market (soon after the crop) at the early market price, opp. <he>תרעא אפלא</he> later market.—Pl. <he>חָרְפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 11:2">Targ. Koh. XI, 2</cite> early seeds.—
<cite ref="Taanit 3b">Taan. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>בח׳</he> concerning early clouds (when rain is gathering).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 8a">R. Hash. 8ᵃ</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>חָרְפְּיָיתָא</he>), v. <cite ref="A02683"><he>אֲפֵילָא</he></cite>.
